clips.title: The story
paras: Pelturas Whitemoon's young daughter Relara remains gripped by a foul and relentless malady, defying the herbal remedies brought from the northern ruins. Desperate for a stronger cure, Pelturas sends an adventurer to Iris Lake to retrieve Elune's Tear, a sacred mineral revered by night elves for its power to wash away corruption.

Relara Whitemoon lies bedridden in Astranaar, wasting away from a virulent sickness of unknown origin. Pelturas had placed his hopes on an alchemical draught prepared from Bathran's hair by the apothecary Orendil Broadleaf. While that brew managed to arrest the rapid advance of the affliction, it fell short of cleansing her body entirely. Facing the bitter reality that ordinary restorative magic and wild herbs are not enough, Pelturas turns to the ancient traditions of his people, pleading for aid in securing remedies imbued with divine cleansing light.

Before parting ways, Orendil shared darker precautions with Pelturas, naming legendary remedies should the herbal mixture prove insufficient. Foremost among them is Elune's Tear, a luminous, sacred stone found only upon an island resting within Iris Lake, east of Astranaar. Believed to carry the blessing of the Moon Goddess, the stone is said to hold the power to purge deep-seated corruption from living flesh. Recovering it is no gentle pilgrimage, as troubled water elementals patrol the shallows and banks of the lake, fiercely guarding the untouched heart of the water.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I had hoped Orendil's cure would save Relara, but I fear it only slowed the disease running through my child. We must find more powerful medicine! Thankfully, Orendil spoke to me of further remedies to try should his first one fail.

Elune's Tear is a type of stone that rests in only one place: the isle on Iris Lake, east of Astranaar. Orendil said the stone will wash away corruption... Please, friend, bring me Elune's Tear and pray it will end my child's sickness!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, did you find Iris Lake? Do you have the Tear?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, you found it! I will place the tear in a stew, and pray that it will cure her.
